entries.summary: A Decisions list shows every open and submitted decision review of the profile, with its chat, progress and status, and a push alert opens a review your agent hands you while no Talaria tab is open.

announcement.title: Decision reviews
announcement.description: Your agent can hand you a decision to review in your own time, with a Decisions list and an alert.

entries.summary: Relay delivers a decision review alert that opens the review, once per review, under the input alert preference.
